title: 974 第五颗圆珠973 仙界的火焰修行
content_zh:
就在洛豪的手指漫无目的地在那一堆杂什之间游走之时，指尖忽然触到了一件冰凉的圆物，他下意识地将那东西拈了出来，定睛一看，竟是一枚晶莹剔透的水晶球。
球体通体澄澈，约莫拳头大小，内里空无一物，仿佛只是寻常的记录法器，然而，洛豪的目光却在触及球面的一瞬间骤然凝滞了——因为在那水晶球光滑如镜的表面之下，隐隐约约透着一道淡金色的暗纹，那道纹路极其细微，若非神识足够敏锐、目力足够锐利，几乎会将它当作水晶本身天然形成的瑕疵而忽略过去。
可洛豪不会忽略，他太熟悉那种金色纹路的形态了，那是一颗圆珠的轮廓，沉稳而内敛，表面流转着一种他见过不止一次的奇异光泽，那形态、那气息、那隐匿于表层之下却难以掩盖的独特韵味，与他混沌书中所藏的那四颗圆珠几乎如出一辙。
他的心脏猛地一跳，像是被一只无形的手骤然攥紧，他找这第五颗圆珠已经太久太久了——自从集齐了前四枚五行圆珠之后，他便隐约感知到，缺了的最后一枚必然与金属性相关，而他无数次推演、四处打探，却始终杳无音讯。
谁能想到，今日竟会在这般偶然的境况下，在这堆看似毫不起眼的零碎物件之中，以这样一个曲折而隐晦的方式，闯入他的视野。
洛豪强压下胸腔里那股几乎要冲出来的悸动，手指却不由自主地将那水晶球握得更紧了些，指节都微微泛白，他将水晶球举到眼前，翻来覆去地端详了好一会儿，表面的那枚金色暗影被他用神识反复确认了数遍，越发笃定这便是他魂牵梦萦的五行金珠。
此刻，他的脑海中已不自觉地浮现出混沌书中那四枚圆珠各自镇守四方、环绕混沌漩涡缓缓旋转的画面——木珠青翠、火珠赤红、土珠昏黄、水珠幽蓝，四者之间隐隐有气机流转，唯独中央空缺一处，虚位以待。
若是能将这枚金珠补入其中，五行圆满，混沌世界便可真正孕育成型，届时他便拥有了属于自己的、独立于仙界之外的一方天地，那片天地将任由他规划布局，可建洞府，可设灵脉，可容至亲挚爱定居其中，与世隔绝，安稳无忧。
念及此处，洛豪的心跳愈发急促起来，几乎连呼吸都有些紊乱，他甚至能感觉到自己的指尖在微微颤抖，那种难以抑制的激动像潮水一般涌遍全身，让他险些失态。
然而，就在这股汹涌的热意快要冲垮理智的堤坝之时，萧中研那若有若无的目光恰好斜斜地飘了过来——那目光不冷不热，却在洛豪心头狠狠浇下一盆冰水。
他猛然间意识到自己的反应太过明显了，若是让这个女人察觉到他对这枚圆珠有着异乎寻常的兴趣，以她的精明与城府，必然会心生疑窦，甚至会顺藤摸瓜地猜到他手中已然持有四枚同源之珠，到那时，他不仅保不住这枚金珠的线索，连自己隐藏多年的秘密都有可能一并暴露。
一念及此，洛豪后背生出一层薄汗，那股激动霎时被警觉与冰冷的理智取代，他甚至在一闪念间掠过了一个极端的念头——杀人灭口，只要萧中研在此刻消失，便无人知晓他看过这水晶球中的画面，更无人会将他与那枚天价金珠联系起来。
这个念头来得迅猛而冷酷，像一条冰蛇沿着脊柱爬上后脑，让他的眼神在刹那之间变得锐利而危险，他不动声色地将水晶球缓缓翻转，借以掩饰眼底闪过的那一道杀意，五指微微收紧，体内的仙元也悄然流转，只消一念便可骤然发难。
然而，就在他心中天人交战、尚未最终决断的那一刻，萧中研却仿佛浑然未觉他方才的杀机，反而语气轻快地将话头岔开了去，她微微偏过头，目光落在洛豪掌心那枚水晶球上，不紧不慢地开口，
"哦，那个东西啊。你若是瞧上了，倒也不是什么稀罕物件。那是我早年参加一场拍卖会时顺手录下来的影像留底，里面那颗圆珠——喏，就是你在球面上看到的那道金色暗影——当日可是拍出了整个拍卖场近千年来最高的成交价。我父亲当时在场，亲口对我说，那种圆珠应当共有五枚，形态纹路皆出一辙，散落各方。我心想着，万一将来侥幸被我碰到另一枚，有了这份记录对照，便能一眼认出来，到时候可不就发了？"
她这番话说得云淡风轻，仿佛只是随口提起一桩旧事，可洛豪听在耳中，心里却是沉沉地一坠，天价——这个词从萧中研嘴里说出来，轻飘飘的，可落在洛豪心头却像一块巨石，压得他胸口发闷。
他太清楚萧中研的出身与眼界了，能被她称之为"天价"的东西，必然远远超出普通修士所能想象的范畴，果然，萧中研像是忽然想起了什么似的，漫不经心地补充，
"对了，那一日那颗圆珠最终的成交价，是十八亿上品仙石，另加一条上品仙灵脉。当时在场的那些老怪物们几乎都疯了，举牌的、传音的、暗中加价的，场面热闹得不得了。"
洛豪闻言，不由倒吸一口凉气，脊背都僵了一瞬，十八亿上品仙石，外加一条上品仙灵脉——这个数字之庞大，几乎让他一时间难以核算出确切的分量。
他固然在林煞星手中攫取了上百条极品灵脉，但那毕竟是横跨了多个位面、历经不知多少万年才累积起来的数目，且那些灵脉皆为修真界之物，无论品质还是蕴含量，都远远无法与仙界的仙灵脉相提并论。

一条上品仙灵脉的价值，只怕抵得过他手中数十条极品修真灵脉的总和，而那颗金珠，竟能以如此骇人的代价被人竞得，可见盯上它的人绝非等闲之辈。
洛豪的眉头微微一蹙，心中那股火热便被冷水浇得只剩下缕缕余烟——能将这种级别的宝物拍走的，必然是仙界中底蕴深厚的一方巨擘，以他目前的修为与势力，根本不可能从对方手中硬抢，甚至连靠近那人都未必有资格。
不过，他很快又收敛了心神，眼下最要紧的，是先把这颗水晶球中的信息牢牢掌控在自己手中，至于日后如何寻得那颗真正的金珠、如何从那位神秘买家手中将它弄到，那是后话，得从长计议。
洛豪不再犹豫，神识如水银泻地般探入水晶球内部，刹那间，一股清晰的影像便在他的识海中铺展开来——那枚圆珠纤毫毕现地悬浮在拍卖台上的光罩之中，金色纹路环绕珠体流转不息，珠面上刻着几个古拙而端凝的大字，他凝神辨认，只见那字迹赫然写着，
"金，齐五行，全世界。"
一字不差，与他混沌书中那四枚圆珠上的铭文互为呼应，这就是五行圆珠中的最后一枚——金属性圆珠，也是他足足寻找了数年而不得的那最关键的一环。
只要将它纳入混沌书中，五行之势立时圆融，天地风雷水火尽皆归位，他那片混沌世界便能完成从残破到完整的最终跃升，真正成为一方有主之界。
届时，他便是那方天地的主人，可掌昼夜，可定四季，可引灵泉、起山岳、开辟万千洞府，将自己所珍视之人一一接入其中，过上与世无争的自在生活，这个念想一旦涌上心头，洛豪的呼吸再次变得粗重起来，他几乎能感受到那片尚未成型的世界正在虚空中向他发出无声的召唤。
然而，萧中研的目光又一次若有深意地扫了过来，这一回，洛豪早有防备，他迅速收敛了眼底所有波澜，将脸上的神情压得淡漠而随意，甚至还故意把水晶球翻了个面，装出一副不过是在研究它品相好坏的漫不经心模样。
可那股杀意却并未完全消散，它只是被掩藏得更深，蛰伏在心底最隐秘的角落，如同一条盘蜷的毒蛇，随时准备在必要时弹射而出，他甚至在暗中盘算着，若萧中研此刻再多说一句引人猜疑的话、多问一个过于深入的问题，他究竟该用何种手段才能做到干净利落、不留后患。
而就在这个微妙的平衡即将被打破的当口，萧中研却忽然话锋一转，语气中带着几分慵懒与大方，朝洛豪笑了笑，
"你到底想好了没有？我这些东西，你若是有哪样瞧得上眼的，尽管拿去便是。就是那水晶球，你若是想要，我回头给你复刻一份影像，也不是什么费事的事。"
content_en:
Just as Luo Hao's fingers were aimlessly wandering among the piles of miscellaneous items, his fingertips suddenly touched a cold round object. He subconsciously took the thing out and took a closer look. It turned out to be a crystal clear crystal ball.
The sphere was completely clear, about the size of a fist, with nothing inside, as if it was just an ordinary recording instrument. However, Luo Hao's eyes suddenly froze the moment he touched the surface of the sphere - because under the smooth mirror-like surface of the crystal ball, there was a faint dark line of pale gold.
But Luo Hao would not ignore it. He was too familiar with the shape of the golden lines. It was the outline of a round bead, calm and restrained, with a strange luster flowing on its surface that he had seen more than once. The shape, the breath, the unique charm hidden under the surface but difficult to conceal, were almost identical to the four round beads hidden in his Chaos Book.
His heart skipped a beat, as if it was suddenly clenched by an invisible hand. He had been looking for the fifth bead for too long. Ever since he collected the first four Five Elements Beads, he had vaguely sensed that the missing last one must be related to metal. However, he had deduced and inquired around countless times, but there was still no news.
Who would have thought that today, under such accidental circumstances, among this pile of seemingly inconspicuous fragmentary objects, it would break into his field of vision in such a tortuous and obscure way.
Luo Hao suppressed the throbbing in his chest that was about to burst out, but his fingers involuntarily held the crystal ball tighter, and his knuckles turned slightly white. He raised the crystal ball in front of his eyes and looked at it over and over for a while. He repeatedly confirmed the golden shadow on the surface several times with his spiritual consciousness, and he became more and more certain that this was the five-element golden bead that he had been dreaming about.
At this moment, the image of the four beads in the book of chaos appeared in his mind unconsciously, each guarding the four directions and slowly rotating around the vortex of chaos - the wooden beads were green, the fire beads were red, the earth beads were dim, and the water beads were blue. There was a faint flow of energy between the four, but there was a vacant spot in the center, waiting for a vacant position.
If this golden bead can be added into it, the five elements will be perfect, and the chaotic world can truly take shape. At that time, he will have his own world, independent of the fairy world.
Thinking of this, Luo Hao's heartbeat became faster and faster, and his breathing was almost disordered. He could even feel his fingertips trembling slightly. The uncontrollable excitement surged through his body like a tide, making him almost lose control.
However, just when this surging heat was about to overwhelm the dam of reason, Xiao Zhongyan's vague gaze happened to drift over sideways - that gaze was neither cold nor hot, but it poured a bucket of ice water on Luo Hao's heart.
He suddenly realized that his reaction was too obvious. If this woman noticed that he had an unusual interest in this bead, with her shrewdness and intelligence, she would definitely be suspicious, and she would even guess that he already held four beads of the same origin. By then, not only would he not be able to keep the clues about this golden bead, but the secrets he had hidden for many years might also be exposed.
At the thought of this, a thin layer of sweat formed on Luo Hao's back. The excitement was instantly replaced by vigilance and cold reason. He even had an extreme idea in a flash - murder and silence. As long as Xiao Zhongyan disappeared at this moment, no one would know that he had seen the picture in the crystal ball, and no one would connect him with the sky-high price gold bead.
This thought came quickly and coldly, like an ice snake crawling up the spine and back of the head, making his eyes sharp in an instant.As for the danger, he calmly turned the crystal ball over slowly to hide the killing intent that flashed in his eyes. His fingers tightened slightly, and the immortal energy in his body also quietly circulated, and he could suddenly attack with just one thought.
However, at the moment when heaven and man were fighting in his heart and the final decision had not yet been made, Xiao Zhongyan seemed completely unaware of his murderous intention. Instead, he changed the topic in a brisk tone. She turned her head slightly, her eyes fell on the crystal ball in Luo Hao's palm, and spoke unhurriedly,
"Oh, that thing. If you take a fancy to it, it's not a rare item. It was an image I recorded when I attended an auction in the early years. The ball inside - well, it's the golden shadow you see on the sphere - sold for nearly a thousand dollars in the entire auction house that day. The highest transaction price in years. My father was present at the time and told me personally that there should be five of those beads, all with the same shape and texture, scattered in various places. I thought, if by chance I come across another one in the future, I will be able to identify it at a glance with this record.
What she said was so light and breezy, as if she was just mentioning an old thing casually, but when Luo Hao heard it, his heart felt heavy. Sky-high price - this word came out of Xiao Zhongyan's mouth, lightly, but it fell on Luo Hao's heart like a huge stone, making his chest feel tight.
He knew Xiao Zhongyan's background and vision very well. What she called "sky-high price" must be far beyond the scope of ordinary monks. Sure enough, Xiao Zhongyan seemed to have suddenly remembered something, and added casually,
"By the way, the final transaction price of the bead that day was 1.8 billion high-grade fairy stones, plus a high-grade fairy spirit vein. The old monsters present at the time were almost crazy. Those who held signs, those who transmitted messages, and those who secretly increased the price, the scene was extremely lively."
When Luo Hao heard this, he couldn't help but take a breath, and his back stiffened for a moment. 1.8 billion high-grade immortal stones, plus a high-grade immortal spiritual vein - this number was so huge that it was almost difficult for him to calculate the exact weight for a while.
Although he had seized hundreds of top-quality spiritual veins from Lin Shaxing, they were a number that spanned multiple planes and had taken countless thousands of years to accumulate. Moreover, those spiritual veins were all from the world of cultivation. Regardless of their quality or content, they were far from being comparable to the fairy spiritual veins in the fairy world.
The value of a top-grade immortal spiritual vein is probably worth the sum of dozens of top-grade cultivation spiritual veins in his hand. And that golden bead can be acquired at such a shocking price, which shows that the person who is eyeing it is by no means an ordinary person.
Luo Hao frowned slightly, and the fire in his heart was poured out by cold water, leaving only wisps of smoke - the person who could take away a treasure of this level must be a giant with profound knowledge in the fairy world. With his current cultivation and power, it is impossible to snatch it from the opponent, and he may not even be qualified to get close to that person.
However, he quickly calmed down. The most important thing at the moment was to firmly control the information in the crystal ball in his own hands. As for how to find the real golden bead in the future and how to get it from the mysterious buyer, that was a matter for later and had to be considered in the long run.
Luo Hao no longer hesitated, and his consciousness penetrated the inside of the crystal ball like mercury pouring down the ground. In an instant, a clear image spread out in his sea of consciousness - the round bead was suspended in the light mask on the auction table, with golden lines flowing around the bead body. There were several ancient and concise characters engraved on the surface of the bead. He concentrated on identifying it, and saw that the handwriting was clearly written,
"Gold, in harmony with the five elements, is the whole world."
It was word for word, echoing the inscriptions on the four beads in his Chaos Book. This was the last of the Five Elements Beads - the metallic bead, and it was also the most critical link that he had been searching for for several years but could not find.
As long as it is included in the book of chaos, fiveThe momentum of the movement will immediately be harmonious, and the heaven, earth, wind, thunder, water, and fire will all return to their places, and his chaotic world will be able to complete the final leap from fragmentation to completeness, and truly become a world with a master.
At that time, he will be the master of the world. He can control the day and night, determine the four seasons, draw spiritual springs, raise mountains, open thousands of caves, connect the people he cherishes one by one, and live a free life free from the world. Once this thought comes to his mind, Luo Hao's breathing becomes heavy again, and he can almost feel that the unformed world is calling him silently in the void.
However, Xiao Zhongyan's eyes once again glanced over thoughtfully. This time, Luo Hao was on guard. He quickly calmed down all the waves in his eyes, suppressed the expression on his face to be indifferent and casual, and even deliberately turned the crystal ball over, pretending to be careless in studying its appearance.
But the murderous intention has not completely dissipated. It has only been hidden deeper, dormant in the most secret corner of his heart, like a coiled poisonous snake, ready to eject when necessary. He is even thinking secretly, if Xiao Zhongyan says one more suspicious word or asks one more question that is too in-depth at this moment, what method should he use to do it cleanly and without leaving any consequences.
But just when this delicate balance was about to be broken, Xiao Zhongyan suddenly changed the subject, with a bit of laziness and generosity in his tone, and smiled at Luo Hao,
"Have you thought about it? If you like any of my things, just take it. As for the crystal ball, if you want it, I can go back and make a copy of the image for you. It's not a troublesome thing."
